mentions.name: Cuentos: Bedtime Story Maker
mentions.description: This iOS app generates AI-created bedtime stories with customization options such as adjustable font size and multiple language choices, including Spanish for bilingual families. It was built to be faster, cheaper, and more customizable than existing AI story apps, which the author found slow, expensive, and lacking font and language options.
mentions.problem: Existing AI bedtime story apps are slow, expensive, barely customizable, and lack font size and language options; the author also needed stories in Spanish for his son and couldn't produce enough stories himself.
mentions.audience: Parents of young kids who want bedtime stories, including bilingual families speaking Spanish to their children.
mentions.source_excerpt:
So I made my own. I've been an iOS developer for 13 years, so it was a fun project. In my opinion it's much better than anything else out there that I've found, but it's not really getting downloads. The app store is just way too saturated with similar things. Anyway, if you have a kid that loves bedtime stories, you should check this out, and I'd love to answer any questions about how I built it, the tech stack, etc...

https://apps.apple.com/us/app/cuentos-bedtime-story-maker/id6754397033
